beats.say: Jerry Hall once performed more gigs in one night than anyone else.
Born on 2 July 1956, she left North Mesquite High School early at 16, and later won a Lifetime Achievement Award from the Fashion Group International Dallas in 2016.
In February 2004 she earned a Guinness World Record for the most musical appearances in a single night.
Now she’s back on TV in the second series of The Celebrity Traitors, airing from October 2026.
Will she keep breaking expectations on the show?
